items.title: Ideal and finite-simulation synthetic likelihood
items.statement: Define the exact summary mean and covariance, the Gaussian synthetic-likelihood density when covariance is positive definite, and the finite-simulation plug-in approximation with its distinct assumptions.

items.statement: For any two vectors in R^2, the Bessel-corrected sample covariance has a nonzero null direction and therefore is not positive definite.

items.title: Finite-simulation synthetic likelihood is a random approximation
items.statement: The finite-simulation plug-in depends on simulation output, may be unavailable when the sample covariance is not positive definite, and is not identified with the true summary likelihood by definition.
